dependency_facts.fact: Null denotes empty dependency; join(null,d)=d; joining does not invent leaves; contains/linearize traverse existing leaf values.
Conditional expression indices use even leaf values; outer assumptions use odd values. Outer reporting negates required conditional literals as well as root assumptions.

Null-dependency assertions are unconditional; nonnull assertions are guarded by retained assumption literals. UNSAT joins only returned active assumption dependencies; null can mean contradiction using only unconditional facts.
Non-null node conflicts accumulate; clear_status does not erase the history. Null conflict skips filtering; null fact handles are conservatively retained.
All-child closure joins the solve-wide conflict history, not only siblings; this over-includes prior leaves. Cache/store/watch lists and conflict history are cleared at each solve entry.

cache_observations: Contributing signatures are active equations, disequations, memberships and negative containments; value clones intentionally omit dependency handles.
Default excluded facets block only when is_satisfied returns false. Backend satisfaction means SAT, not no live constraints. Power and assumption facets always return true.
Eligibility therefore is not itself a proof that omitted live state is irrelevant; fixed background versus branch-local premises must be justified.
Cache scope is one solve call, including iterative-deepening rounds. Cross-solve or across-outer-assignment cache persistence is not an established concern.
A dependency leaf may refer to a temporary exact-length view rather than a signature constraint. Subset inclusion does not put that premise into a cached core.
The prior P19 identity mismatch can suppress multi-literal hits; a questionable stored core is not automatically a reachable wrong pruning result.
